describes: packages/core/main: the kernel, its store, plan, scopes and document lifecycle.

cases.name: open-a-document
cases.covers: The ready path end to end: slot reserved synchronously as loading, the engine open, pages.list, bring-up (slices, init, effects) in plugin order, and the one commit that swaps the pending slot for the document.

cases.name: tabs-keep-request-order
cases.covers: Two opens whose engine calls complete in the reverse order: the tab strip keeps request order, and activation was decided at request time (the second open activates, the first does not steal focus back).

cases.name: activate-false-and-first-open
cases.covers: `activate: false` leaves the active tab alone unless there is none, in which case the first tab is always selected.

cases.name: open-all
cases.covers: `openAll` reserves every slot at once in array order, selects exactly the `active` entry (else the first), and turns a failure into tab state rather than a rejection.

cases.name: open-all-defaults-to-first
cases.covers: With no `active` entry the first document is selected.

cases.name: close-while-opening
cases.covers: close() during the engine open: the tab disappears synchronously, open() rejects with the typed cancellation, and a handle that lands afterwards is closed rather than leaked.

cases.name: close-during-pages-list
cases.covers: close() while pages.list is in flight aborts the engine call (the kernel retains it for exactly this) and the open rejects as cancelled.

cases.name: close-during-init
cases.covers: close() while a plugin init is pending: inits are joined, not raced, so close waits for the init; the session then disposes and open rejects as cancelled.

cases.name: open-failure-parks-an-error-tab
cases.covers: An engine refusal after the slot is reserved: rollback, then an `error` tab that is closable and reopenable, with the rejection carried on the pending slot.

cases.name: bring-up-failure-rolls-back
cases.covers: A plugin init that throws after the handle is open: the session scope unwinds (slices removed, the handle closed) and the tab parks as `error`; the document was never ready.

cases.name: effect-setup-failure-rolls-back
cases.covers: Effect setup is part of the transaction: a throwing effects() rolls the open back like a failed init.

cases.name: pages-list-failure
cases.covers: pages.list rejecting is an open failure like any other.

cases.name: duplicate-open-refuses
cases.covers: Opening an id that already has a session throws synchronously and changes nothing.

cases.name: password-locked-then-unlocked
cases.covers: A handle whose prompt is `required` parks as `locked` before pages.list; a wrong password rejects and changes nothing; the right one runs bring-up and promotes to ready.

cases.name: password-provided-is-remembered
cases.covers: A password supplied at open, in the options or on the input, marks the locked tab `passwordProvided` (the "incorrect" copy).

cases.name: unlock-concurrency-and-cancellation
cases.covers: A second unlock while one is in flight refuses (one transition at a time); closing during an unlock cancels it; unlock on an unknown document refuses.

cases.name: unlock-then-bring-up-fails
cases.covers: Past the password, a failure is an open failure: rollback and an `error` tab.

cases.name: unlock-then-close-during-pages-list
cases.covers: Closing after the password but before bring-up commits cancels the unlock.

cases.name: thunk-source
cases.covers: A thunk source reserves a ticket slot (`pending:N`), runs under the loading tab with the cancellation signal, and the slot is re-keyed to the real id atomically once the input names one.

cases.name: thunk-source-failures
cases.covers: A thunk that rejects parks its ticket as `error`; a thunk that throws synchronously does too; closing a ticket while its fetch runs aborts the signal the thunk was handed.

cases.name: handle-id-differs
cases.covers: An engine that answers with a handle whose id differs from the requested one re-keys the session; a re-key onto an id already in use refuses and parks the tab as error.

cases.name: input-without-id
cases.covers: An input that carries no id gets a ticket, then takes the handle id.

cases.name: page-registry-events
cases.covers: A pages.* mutation event swaps the registry in place and bumps the revision; any other event is ignored; an event for a closed document is ignored.

cases.name: render-policy
cases.covers: The render policy is read once in bring-up and lands on the meta; an engine without a render service, or a failed read, means `continuous`.

cases.name: capability-resolution
cases.covers: Workspace singletons; document instances built lazily, once per document; the truthful refusals for no provider, no active document, an unknown document and a loading one; tryCapability counting only ready documents; scopeOf.

cases.name: context-resolution-from-plugins
cases.covers: A plugin's own get/tryGet/forDocument: bring-up counts for tryGet inside the plugin, sibling document capabilities resolve for the bound document, and forDocument crosses to another one.

cases.name: dispatch-and-watch
cases.covers: dispatch targets the bound slice; a reducer returning the same state emits no change (so a reference watch does not fire), a new state does; action listeners see every dispatch either way.

cases.name: active-document-and-order
cases.covers: setActive (a pending tab is selectable, an unknown id is ignored), move with clamping, swap, and the next-active rule when the active tab closes: the tab before it, else the first.

cases.name: close-first-active
cases.covers: Closing the active tab when it is first selects the new first tab.

cases.name: document-io
cases.covers: download and downloadLayer go straight to the handle; both refuse with no document; downloadLayer refuses on an engine without layers; allows answers from the handle and is false with no document.

$error.name: Error
$error.message: [documents] this engine cannot export a layer (open with a layer on the local engine)

cases.name: start-lifecycle
cases.covers: start runs workspace inits in plan order and then workspace effects; a second start joins the first; status moves created → starting → started.

cases.name: start-failure
cases.covers: A workspace init that rejects fails the kernel terminally: the workspace scope unwinds, start rejects, a later start refuses, capability and open refuse, destroy stays legal.

cases.name: destroy-during-start
cases.covers: destroy while a workspace init is pending: start stops at its next check, destroy joins it, and nothing after the pending init runs.

cases.name: destroy-closes-everything
cases.covers: destroy closes every session (a mid-close one included), unwinds document scopes LIFO in reverse dependency order, then the workspace scope, then refuses further use; a teardown registered after disposal runs immediately.

cases.name: teardown-after-dispose
cases.covers: A cleanup registered on a scope that already disposed runs as soon as it is registered, instead of being dropped.

cases.name: teardown-failures-are-reported
cases.covers: A teardown that throws is reported and the rest still run; a listener that throws is reported and its siblings still run.

cases.name: missing-dependency
cases.covers: A required token nobody provides fails construction, and the message carries the token's own remedy.

$error.name: Error
$error.message: Plugin "needs" requires capability "absent", which no plugin provides.

cases.name: missing-dependency-with-hint
cases.covers: The hint is appended to the missing-dependency message.

requiresHint.needed-token: add neededPlugin() from '@x/y' to your plugins list

$error.name: Error
$error.message: Plugin "needs" requires capability "needed-token", which no plugin provides — add neededPlugin() from '@x/y' to your plugins list.

cases.name: dependency-cycle
cases.covers: A requires cycle fails construction naming a plugin in it.

cases.name: plan-order
cases.covers: Dependencies are initialised before dependents regardless of list order, optional dependencies order too, a plugin optional on itself is not a cycle, and a token without a capability provides nothing.

cases.name: capability-constructor-throws
cases.covers: A workspace capability that throws while being built fails construction; a document one throws at resolution and is not cached.

cases.name: document-capability-constructor-throws
cases.covers: A document capability that throws at build is a bug and propagates out of resolution, every time.

cases.name: listener-isolation
cases.covers: A watcher that throws is reported; the change still reaches the other listeners and the dispatch completes.

cases.name: close-during-init-then-init-fails
cases.covers: An init that rejects after close() won is still a cancellation, not a failure: no error tab, nothing reported.

cases.name: an-abort-error-from-the-engine-reads-as-cancelled
cases.covers: An engine call rejecting with AbortError when nobody closed the tab: the open rejects as cancelled and the tab stays loading, which is what isAbortLike does to an abort the kernel did not start.

cases.name: an-abort-error-after-unlock-reads-as-cancelled
cases.covers: The same rule past the password.

cases.name: plain-promise-engine-late-handle
cases.covers: An engine whose calls cannot be aborted: close() does not wait for the open, and the handle that lands afterwards is closed through the disposed scope rather than leaked.

cases.name: rekey-keeps-another-active-tab
cases.covers: Re-keying a ticket that is not the active tab leaves the active tab alone.

cases.name: close-joins-a-close-in-flight
cases.covers: A second close while the first is still disposing returns the same close.

cases.name: close-during-rollback-reports-the-failure
cases.covers: close() arriving while a failed open is still rolling back joins that operation, and the real failure it rejects with is reported.

cases.name: page-event-before-commit
cases.covers: A page mutation event that arrives during bring-up, before the document is published, changes nothing.

cases.name: try-get-across-scopes
cases.covers: A document plugin's tryGet resolves a workspace capability; a workspace plugin's tryGet of a document capability is null while the active document is still loading; allows() is false for a loading document.

cases.name: a-capability-outlives-its-document
cases.covers: A capability kept after its document closed: dispatch reaches no slice and does nothing, state reads undefined, and document() falls back to the meta staged at bring-up.

cases.name: a-listener-dispatching-mid-pass
cases.covers: A state watcher that dispatches from inside its handler: the store finishes the pass it is in, then runs another, so listener order stays deterministic.

cases.name: a-plugin-with-no-reducer
cases.covers: A plugin without a reducer keeps its initial state whatever it dispatches.

cases.name: destroy-during-the-last-init
cases.covers: destroy() while the last workspace init is pending: start stops before running any effects.

cases.name: destroy-during-a-start-that-fails
cases.covers: destroy() while start is pending, and start then fails: destroy reports the failure, since the kernel was not already failed when destroy began.
